sink.comment: One of: snowflake | cosmos | adls | onelake. Snowflake is the default for backward compatibility.

snowflake.comment: Connection details (account/user/password/warehouse/database/schema) come from env vars.

cosmos.comment_endpoint: https://<account>.documents.azure.com:443/  (or https://localhost:8081 for emulator). Set via env COSMOS_ENDPOINT.
cosmos.comment_auth: aad => DefaultAzureCredential (managed identity / az login). Falls back to COSMOS_KEY env var if set (use only for emulator/dev).
cosmos.comment_ttl: Maps to Dataverse 90-day default audit retention. Set 0 / null to disable TTL.

adls.comment_target: adls (Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2) or onelake (Microsoft Fabric Lakehouse). OneLake auto-resolves account_url to https://onelake.dfs.fabric.microsoft.com.
adls.comment_account_name: ADLS Gen2 storage account name (without .dfs.core.windows.net). Ignored for onelake. Override via ADLS_ACCOUNT_NAME env var.
adls.comment_account_url: Optional - explicit URL beats account_name. Override via ADLS_ACCOUNT_URL env var.
adls.comment_filesystem: ADLS Gen2: container name. OneLake: '<workspace>/<lakehouse>.Lakehouse/Files' style path piece. Override via ADLS_FILESYSTEM env var.
adls.comment_root_path: Sub-folder within filesystem under which audit/ and _state/ live.

modeAutoDetect.comment: If lastSyncEnd is older than backlog_threshold_minutes, use backlog window size; otherwise continuous

auth.comment_authority: {tenant} placeholder is replaced with TENANT_ID env var at runtime.
auth.comment_scope: {org} placeholder is replaced with DATAVERSE_ORG_URL env var at runtime.

features.comment_exit_when_caught_up: If true, exits after catching up (good for one-shot/function). If false, sleeps and continues (good for long-running console/container).
